title: Mlai senior systemdesign build vs buy infra
topic: Mlai senior systemdesign build vs buy infra
question: How would you approach this build-versus-buy decision?
idealAnswer:
Start from whether this capability is a genuine competitive differentiator for the company or plumbing infrastructure that every ML-driven company needs, differentiating capabilities are worth building in-house, commodity infrastructure usually isn't

Weigh total cost of ownership honestly, an existing solution has license and usage costs, but a built solution has ongoing engineering, on-call, and maintenance costs that are easy to underestimate and rarely go away

Consider time-to-value, buying or adopting existing tools lets teams start shipping ML products now, building in-house delays every dependent team until the platform is ready

Evaluate whether existing solutions actually meet the specific scale, latency, or feature requirements the company needs, if they fall meaningfully short in a way that matters, that's a real argument for building

Consider lock-in and flexibility risk in both directions, vendor lock-in with a managed solution versus the ongoing burden of maintaining a bespoke system as requirements evolve over years

A senior answer looks for a middle path where reasonable, e.g. adopting an open-source solution and operating it themselves, rather than treating it as a strict binary build-or-buy choice
